name: The Family Crypt
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge.  Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered.  With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.

This cannot pass, and you must stop it.  Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.

And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.
narrative.objectives:
Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.

Kill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge. And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the Forsaken, nor by our enemies.

Continue the struggle as we all do, adventurer, and one day we will drive the Lich King himself from Azeroth!
narrative.requestItemsText: Time is not a luxury we have, adventurer. With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.
